topics.title: What is NestJS?
topics.summary: NestJS nima ekanligi va uning asosiy konsepsiyalari

blocks.text: NestJS — bu samarali, ishonchli va kengaytiriladigan server-side Node.js dasturlarini yaratish uchun framework.

U zamonaviy JavaScript-dan foydalanadi va TypeScript bilan to'liq qo'llab-quvvatlanadi. NestJS OOP (Obyektga yo'naltirilgan dasturlash), FP (Funksional dasturlash) va FRP (Reaktiv dasturlash) elementlarini o'zida mujassam etgan.
NestJS ichki tomondan Express (sukut bo'yicha) yoki Fastify kabi kuchli HTTP server framework'laridan foydalanadi.

examples.title: Nest arxitekturasining qatlamlari
examples.code:
const layers = [
    ["Middleware", "har qanday so'rov uchun, route'ni bilmaydi"],
    ["Guard", "ruxsat bor-yo'qligini hal qiladi"],
    ["Interceptor (oldin)", "so'rovni o'rab oladi, vaqtni o'lchaydi"],
    ["Pipe", "parametrlarni tekshiradi va aylantiradi"],
    ["Controller → Service", "asosiy biznes mantiq"],
    ["Interceptor (keyin)", "javobni o'zgartiradi"],
    ["Exception filter", "xato bo'lsa — javobni shakllantiradi"],
]

layers.forEach(([name, desc], i) => console.log(`${i + 1}. ${name.padEnd(22)} ${desc}`))

topics.title: How the Examples Work
topics.summary: Misollardagi testApp yordamchisi va natijalarni o'qish

blocks.text: Ushbu bo'limdagi misollarning deyarli hammasi **haqiqatan ishga tushirilib** tekshirilgan: har bir misolda kichik Nest ilovasi ko'tariladi, unga HTTP so'rov yuboriladi va javob **"Natija"** oynasida ko'rsatiladi.
Kodni qisqa saqlash uchun misollarda `testApp()` degan kichik yordamchi funksiya ishlatiladi. U NestJS'ning bir qismi **emas** — uni o'zingiz yozasiz yoki uning o'rniga Postman/curl ishlatasiz.

items: `http.get()`, `http.post()` va boshqa metodlar bilan so'rov yuboradi.
Har bir javobni `METHOD /yo'l → status javob` ko'rinishida chiqaradi.

blocks.text: Masalan, `GET /users/7 → 200 {"id":7}` qatori: `/users/7` manziliga GET so'rov yuborildi, server **200** status bilan `{"id":7}` javob qaytardi degani.
Haqiqiy loyihada xuddi shu so'rovlarni terminalda `curl http://localhost:3000/users/7` bilan yoki Postman/Insomnia dasturida yuborishingiz mumkin.

examples.code:
const examples = [
    ['http.get("/users")', "curl http://localhost:3000/users"],
    ['http.post("/users", { name: "Ali" })', `curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/users -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name":"Ali"}'`],
    ['http.patch("/users/1", { name: "Vali" })', `curl -X PATCH http://localhost:3000/users/1 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name":"Vali"}'`],
    ['http.delete("/users/1")', "curl -X DELETE http://localhost:3000/users/1"],
    ['http.get("/me", { authorization: "Bearer t" })', `curl http://localhost:3000/me -H "Authorization: Bearer t"`],
]

for (const [code, curl] of examples) console.log(`${code}\n  → ${curl}\n`)

Status kodlar ma'nosi — http.STATUS_CODES

import { STATUS_CODES } from "node:http"

for (const code of [200, 201, 204, 301, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503]) console.log(code, "→", STATUS_CODES[code])
examples.output:
200 → OK
201 → Created
204 → No Content
301 → Moved Permanently
400 → Bad Request
401 → Unauthorized
403 → Forbidden
404 → Not Found
409 → Conflict
413 → Payload Too Large
422 → Unprocessable Entity
429 → Too Many Requests
500 → Internal Server Error
503 → Service Unavailable
